Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CURRENT STATE / GOAL
Three duplicants: Ashkan, Bubbles, Gossmann. Verified: outhouse use, diffuser oxygen output, replacement pump water availability and bottled pickup, wash basin built/supplied, one finished Mush Bar, three completed/assigned cots. Bed and Bath achievement earned (at least one toilet and a bed for every duplicant). No terminal/episode result observed. Current development goal: obtain metal ore, build/connect a Battery; none placed yet. Battery stores 10 kJ and requires 200 kg metal ore; last inventory 89.6 kg Copper Ore. An identified 344.7 kg copper tile immediately right of the Musher is now reachable and actively being dug by Bubbles; Gossmann digs below it. Latest observation: both excavation progress bars partially filled, copper inventory still 89.6 kg. LAST ACTION was a completed 5-second wait; no subsequent observation supplied. Dig tool may still be active (reactivated for access digging and not subsequently dismissed).

CONTROLS / UI
Coordinates normalized and view-dependent. Click selects; hover gives tooltip; drag designates dig/ladders/wires. g activates Dig, Escape dismisses tools/menus. Successful execution alone does not establish placement/completion. Drag sometimes missed its starting tile; inspect marks and click individual missed tiles. a/d held .5s pan left/right. Scroll over world changes zoom; scroll over a panel scrolls that panel. Current view is zoomed out THREE steps from earlier main-floor views; old coordinates are obsolete.
Bottom menus: Base (.028,.936), Oxygen (.064,.937), Power (.100,.937), Food (.135,.937), Plumbing (.169,.936), Medicine (.277,.936), Furniture (.314,.936). First item (.045,.777): Diffuser, Generator, Musher, Pump, or Cot in respective menus. Power Wire (.100,.777), Battery (.153,.777). Outhouse (.099,.777); Wash Basin Medicine (.099,.657); Base Ladder (.045,.655).
Pause (.086,.077), slow/single triangle (.110,.077), fastest visible (.145,.077), SPACE pause, Tab speed. Selecting speed does not reliably unpause. Many unchanged waits prompted speculative pause toggles; later character movement and progress proved simulation advancing. Tooltip Pause [SPACE] alone did not establish paused state. Avoid endless toggling based solely on slow jobs; construction/cooking did ultimately finish after many 5s waits.
Schedule (.791,.038), close (.975,.149), Work brush (.682,.354), Bedtime brush (.902,.354). Generic building panel Status (.819,.330), Errands (.884,.335), close (.978,.273); Musher panel instead Status/Errands y=.253, close (.977,.191). Incorrect generic close at y=.196 opened Diagnostics once; its close (.777,.147). Priority 8 (.905,.800), 7 (.892,.800). Built pump deconstruction priority8 (.905,.759), Deconstruct (.834,.799). Show Navigation duplicant (.835,.798). Power overlay (.794,.094).

SCHEDULE / COLONY
Original shared schedule Downtime → three Bedtime blocks → Bathtime → Work. Temporarily changed last two bedtime blocks (.741,.298), (.767,.298) to Work after Ashkan reached 100% stamina; workers woke and dug pump access. Drag changed only final block, direct clicks fixed it. At Cycle 2 Bathtime, BOTH blocks restored with Bedtime brush; three dark-blue blocks verified. No restoration outstanding. Gossmann later had Sore Back and 77% stamina; this preceded cot assignment. Earlier Diagnostics Beds 0/3 and Breathability88% now superseded by three assigned beds. Oxygen near cots later 2317.3 g Very Breathable. Latest recorded food total16,062 kcal.

WATER / SANITATION COMPLETED
First pump built but Empty: its intake hovered CO2 above water (reservoir tile999.9 kg). Deconstructed fully; lower replacement placed with intake visibly in water. Bank excavation was actual access blocker (Unreachable Dig), not absent reservoir water. Priority8 reachable bank digging resumed after schedule change, cleared footprint; Gossmann then had Build current errand and completed replacement. Pump Status Liquid Available Water1920.2 kg, later about1999.4 kg. Empty Available Errands did NOT mean unable to pump: Gossmann visibly operated it, white bottle appeared, then notification Picked Up:200 kg Water and Bubbles carrying bottle confirmed collection. Pump availability fluctuated thereafter.
Wash Basin costs50 kg raw mineral, uses5 kg water and produces5 kg polluted water per use; spans2 floor tiles. Attempts between outhouse/ladder/diffuser failed occupied. Valid site left of food box/central machine queued with click (.455,.829) in PRE-ZOOM view; subsequent red preview meant overlap with new blueprint, not failure. Misread24.4 t sandstone as24.4 kg was corrected. Bubbles received50 kg sandstone and completed basin. Direction Both. Panel contents later explicitly195 kg Water and5.1 kg Polluted Water: delivery confirmed, contents support use having occurred (no directly observed wash animation). Basin now left of food box; old selection before zoom (.203,.803). Preserve reservoir retaining floor/wall.

FOOD / POWER
Generator connected to diffuser and Musher; power overlay observed400 W generator,120 W and240 W consumers. Ashkan repeatedly operated generator. Musher originally No Fabrications Queued; Mush Bar recipe showed Undiscovered ingredients despite supplies sufficient. Selecting Water's empty ingredient circle (.556,.576) actually unlocked controls; waiting for discovery was unnecessary. Recipe needs75 kg Dirt +75 kg Water. Select Mush Bar row (.658,.582), increment right arrow (.481,.836) queued ONE. Delivered75 kg Dirt observed. Then Waiting For Materials/Insufficient Resources Water75 kg; one Cook Supply remained. Gossmann also disinfected machine; In Use alone didn't prove cooking. After water pickup, status became Work Errand, Cook assigned Bubbles, then explicitly In Use / Producing Mush Bar. Long waits and partially filled progress eventually finished: food15,262→16,062 kcal (+800), Mush Bar label and resource listing1 Mush Bar800 kcal. Only ONE batch queued; no repeat production configured. Musher water supply inferred from actual successful production, not a delivery notification.

BEDS / NAVIGATION
Three cots built on broad upper shelf above equipment, reached b
